t: RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT ON BIOMASS ENERGY SYSTEMS: (I) DEVELOPMENT OF A PROTOCOL FOR PRODUCING LOW-COST BIODIESEL FROM NON-EDIBLE OILS AND THEIR BLENDS USING GREEN SYNTHESIZED NANOPARTICLES: ASTM D613 D6890 AUTOMATIC BIODIESEL CETANE NUMBER TESTER FOR BIODIESEL; VISCOMETER, VSC- P80; DIESEL ENGINE 3KVA FOR SAMPLE TESTING; (II) BIODIESEL SEED PRESS EXTRACTOR AND BIODIESEL PROCESSOR WITH AGITATOR AND HEATING DEVICE BLENDING OF COAL WITH BIOMASS MATERIALS (BIO-COAL BRIQUETTES), FURTHER RESEARCH ON COAL- LIQUID MIXTURES WITH DIFFERENT COAL TYPES
